source_kind: derived aggregate over retained EPA ECHO accepted active-program-facility source rows
ownership: EPA publishes the retained source records. Co*Tive owns only the aggregate transformation.
terms: Inherits the retained EPA ECHO source policy; no new acquisition or source access is performed.
allowed_use: exact reported NAICS memberships by ZIP5
reported state/DC and separate territory aggregate evidence
prohibited_use: unique businesses, independently verified sites, current business operation or completeness claims
adding overlapping exact NAICS memberships or this existing ECHO cohort to generic business totals
primary-code selection, prefix expansion or operational-industry mapping without a governed crosswalk
claiming an official NAICS edition or validating code existence from syntax alone
publishing names, addresses, coordinates, FRS/program/record identifiers, URLs, geometry, quarantine or raw records
joining reported ZIP4, using ZCTA as USPS validity, or assigning state from ZIP/ZCTA
retention: Retain immutable derivative releases and pinned dependency metadata until approved removal.
redistribution: No public export or production enrollment is authorized by this derivative.
personal_data_handling: Aggregate counts and exact classification strings only; source identifiers stay in bounded verification memory.
attribution: Source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Enforcement and Compliance History Online Exporter; source update 2026-08-30.
